## Summary
Create the Inngest function skeleton for the P3 batch generation pipeline with all 6 step placeholders, concurrency controls, and rate limiting.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want the generation pipeline infrastructure in place, so that subsequent stories can implement each pipeline step independently.

## Why this matters
Without the scaffold, no generation step can be implemented. This is the spine that all other E05 stories attach to. If the concurrency or rate limiting is wrong, faculty could accidentally trigger expensive parallel batches (C10).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `journey/items.batch-generate` Inngest function registered and visible in Inngest dev server
- [ ] Function has 6 named step placeholders: `ecd-stages`, `hyde-context`, `generate-core`, `generate-distractors`, `rationale-qa`, `provenance-write`
- [ ] Concurrency limit: 3 concurrent per faculty (keyed on `event.data.faculty_id`)
- [ ] Function timeout: 30 minutes
- [ ] Retry policy: 2 retries with exponential backoff
- [ ] Triggered by `journey/generation.spec-confirmed` event
- [ ] Includes `step.waitForEvent('journey/items.batch-reviewed', { timeout: '30d' })` placeholder
- [ ] Rate limit: 100/day per faculty
- [ ] Cost confirmation gate: if item_count > 10, requires explicit confirmation
- [ ] Event type definitions added to packages/types/events.ts

## Inngest event context
Function: `journey/items.batch-generate`

Events triggered: none (placeholders only)
Events consumed: `journey/generation.spec-confirmed`
onFailure: Log to dead letter queue, emit `journey/generation.failed` with batch_id + error

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
import { inngest } from '../client';

export const p3BatchGenerate = inngest.createFunction(
  {
    id: 'journey/items.batch-generate',
    concurrency: [{ limit: 3, key: 'event.data.faculty_id' }],
    retries: 2,
    rateLimit: { limit: 100, period: '1d', key: 'event.data.faculty_id' },
  },
  { event: 'journey/generation.spec-confirmed' },
  async ({ event, step }) => {
    // Step 1: ECD stages
    const ecdResult = await step.run('ecd-stages', async () => {
      // E05-S03 implements
      return { taskShellId: '', proficiencyVars: [] };
    });

    // Step 2: HyDE context assembly
    const context = await step.run('hyde-context', async () => {
      // E05-S04 implements
      return { local: '', structured: '', lod: '', global: '' };
    });

    // ... remaining steps
  }
);
```

## Automated tests (Playwright -- runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E05/E05-S01.pipeline.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Inngest function journey/items.batch-generate is registered', async ({ request }) => {
  // Verify function appears in Inngest dev server function list
  const res = await request.get('http://localhost:8288/v1/functions');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const functions = await res.json();
  const p3Fn = functions.find((f: any) => f.id === 'journey/items.batch-generate');
  expect(p3Fn).toBeDefined();
  expect(p3Fn.concurrency).toEqual([{ limit: 3, key: 'event.data.faculty_id' }]);
});

test('Negative: function rejects event without faculty_id', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post('http://localhost:8288/v1/e/journey/generation.spec-confirmed', {
    data: { data: {} }
  });
  // Should fail validation -- faculty_id required
  expect(res.status()).not.toBe(200);
});
```
